title: Aggregating the Cotangent Sum: ∑ 1/(2‖a/q‖) = O(q log q)
description: Completes the Pólya–Vinogradov aggregation step of the bounded-prime-gaps development by proving the elementary bound S(q) = ∑_{a=1}^{q-1} 1/(2‖a/q‖) ≤ q·H_{q-1} ≤ q·(1 + log q) = O(q log q). It uses the exact nearest-integer identity ‖a/q‖ = min(a,q−a)/q (dist_frac_eq) and a single reflection of the index set, reusing Mathlib’s harmonic_le_one_add_log for the harmonic→log step. 0 axioms, 0 sorries.
